paragraphs.label: Mở chủ đề
paragraphs.text: I would like to talk about the benefits of travelling. A trip can do more than give us photographs to share. It can provide a break from daily routines, support businesses in the destination and help us understand places beyond our own neighbourhood.

paragraphs.label: Thư giãn
paragraphs.text: First, travelling can help people feel refreshed. Spending a few days in a different setting gives us something new to focus on instead of the same work and household tasks. For example, a quiet weekend by the sea might give a busy office worker time to rest and return with more energy.

paragraphs.label: Kinh tế
paragraphs.text: Travelling also supports the economy of the places we visit. Visitors pay for rooms, meals, transport and local activities. paragraphs.label: Mở chủ đề
paragraphs.text: I support encouraging teenagers to read regularly. Reading offers a quiet activity that they can choose for themselves, and it can help with knowledge, relaxation and remembering information. The aim should be to build an enjoyable habit, not to turn every book into another school test.

parts.text: I support encouraging teenagers to read regularly. Reading offers a quiet activity that they can choose for themselves, and it can help with knowledge, relaxation and remembering information. The aim should be to build an enjoyable habit, not to turn every book into another school test.

paragraphs.label: Kiến thức
paragraphs.text: First, books can introduce teenagers to subjects beyond their daily experience. A story set in another country may lead a reader to learn about a different way of life, while a simple science book can explain how ordinary things work. Reading also exposes learners to words used in meaningful situations.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu cách hình thành kiến thức, không chỉ nói good.

paragraphs.label: Thư giãn
paragraphs.text: Another benefit is relaxation. Following an interesting story can give a teenager a break from messages, homework and social pressure. For example, reading a few pages before bed may provide a calmer end to the day than moving rapidly between short online videos. The book needs to match the reader’s interests for this to be enjoyable.

paragraphs.label: Mở
paragraphs.text: I would like to talk about the opportunities that come from learning another language. Even basic skills can make some everyday situations easier, and stronger skills can open further possibilities. Three useful benefits are communicating with more people, taking part in different kinds of work and understanding cultures more directly.

paragraphs.label: Giao tiếp
paragraphs.text: First, another language allows us to speak to people we might otherwise struggle to understand. A traveller can ask for directions, explain a simple problem or have a short conversation with a host. These exchanges can make a visit more independent and personal than relying on someone else for every message.

Finally, language gives us a closer connection to another culture. Songs, stories and ordinary conversations can reveal humour and habits that are difficult to translate fully. For example, learning how people make polite requests can teach us something about social relationships as well as vocabulary and grammar.

coverage.evidence: First, students can learn simple ways to manage money. Planning a small budget helps them see the difference between essential costs and optional purchases. For example, a class activity could ask students to divide a limited weekly allowance between transport, food and savings. The purpose is understanding choices, not teaching everyone to follow an identical spending pattern.

Basic household skills are useful when students move away from home. Knowing how to prepare a simple meal, read a washing label or keep a shared kitchen clean can prevent avoidable difficulties. These tasks also show that looking after a home involves work that should be shared fairly rather than left automatically to one person.

Practical lessons can also develop decision-making. Students might compare phone plans by looking at total cost and what they actually need, instead of choosing the most attractive advertisement. Explaining their choice encourages them to ask questions and consider consequences. That habit can transfer to many ordinary decisions outside school.

paragraphs.label: Mở
paragraphs.text: Flexible working arrangements can benefit employees when the job allows them and expectations are clear. Flexibility may involve different starting times or some work from home, rather than simply working fewer hours. It can help people manage personal responsibilities, reduce commuting pressure and organise tasks around periods when they can concentrate well.

paragraphs.label: Trách nhiệm cá nhân
paragraphs.text: First, adjustable hours can make it easier to manage responsibilities outside work. The arrangement needs to be agreed with the employer so that colleagues know when the person is available.

paragraphs.label: Mở
paragraphs.text: I would like to talk about the value of local shops. Online shopping and large supermarkets are convenient, but small shops can still contribute something important to a neighbourhood. They can support local employment, offer personal service and give residents reasons to spend time in the streets around their homes.
paragraphs.noteVi: Luận điểm không phủ nhận các hình thức mua sắm khác.

They can support local employment, offer personal service and give residents reasons to spend time in the streets around their homes.

paragraphs.label: Việc làm
paragraphs.text: First, local shops create work for owners and staff, and some buy supplies from nearby businesses. A small bakery, for instance, might employ local assistants and use a nearby delivery service. When customers choose to shop there regularly, they help maintain those jobs. This does not mean every product is locally made, so the benefit depends on the business.

questions.answer: They may find a wider range of products in one place and prefer predictable opening hours. For someone with little shopping time, that convenience can be important. Price comparisons also influence the choice.
